title: Apply to move a grape harvester in the Hunter Valley
summary: Find out if you need a permit and how to apply if your over-size grape harvester needs to travel on NSW roads.
intro:
If your registered grape harvester is over-size (over 2.5 metres wide), you may need to apply for a permit to travel on NSW roads.

You’ll need a permit if you cannot comply with the conditions set out in the latest gazette notice.

You can apply online, by post or fax.
who_can_apply: The registered grape harvester is over-size (over 2.5 metres wide).
The harvester cannot comply with the conditions set out in the latest gazette notice.
what_you_need: Your vehicle dimensions, loaded axle mass and spacings
The PDF form – 'Agricultural vehicle permit application' (unless applying online)

how_to_steps.text: Gather your supporting information and documents.
Follow the prompts to apply for a permit.

more_info.text: For more information, refer to the NHVR website.
For support with your application, contact the NHVR.

external_links.text: conditions set out in the latest gazette notice

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for my grape harvester?
faqs.a: You may need a permit if your registered grape harvester is over-size (over 2.5 metres wide) or if you cannot comply with the conditions set out in the latest gazette notice.

faqs.q: How can I apply for the permit?
faqs.a: You can apply online, by post, or by fax.

faqs.q: What is the first step to applying for the permit?
faqs.a: Gather your supporting information and documents.
